extracted.intended_audience: researchers, developers, and organizations interested in building automated model-discovery systems (data scientists, subject-matter experts, DARPA performers)
extracted.subtask_description: Develop automated model-discovery systems that let subject-matter experts (without data-science backgrounds) create robust empirical models by composing reusable primitives, with human-model interaction for problem definition and curation, and that are validated on progressively harder real-world problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robust empirical models for prediction and what-if analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Construction of robust empirical models — representations of real, complex systems that enable decision makers to predict behaviors and answer 'what-if' questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understanding the complex and increasingly data-intensive world around us relies on the construction of robust empirical models, i.e., representations of real, complex systems that enable decision makers to predict behaviors and answer 'what-if' questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable users without data-science backgrounds
rubrics_metrics.description: Systems must enable users with subject matter expertise but no data science background to create empirical models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The D3M program aims to develop automated model discovery systems that enable users with subject matter expertise but no data science background to create empirical models of real, complex processes. This capability will enable subject matter experts to create empirical models without the need for data scientists...

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase productivity of expert data scientists via automation
rubrics_metrics.description: Systems should increase the productivity of expert data scientists through automation of model construction tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ...and will increase the productivity of expert data scientists via automation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library of selectable primitives
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a discoverable archive of data modeling primitives that serve as the basic building blocks for complex modeling pipelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A library of selectable primitives. A discoverable archive of data modeling primitives will be developed to serve as the basic building blocks for complex modeling pipelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated composition of complex models
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques to automatically select model primitives and compose them into complex modeling pipelines based on user-specified data and desired outcome(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automated composition of complex models. Techniques will be developed for automatically selecting model primitives and for composing selected primitives into complex modeling pipelines based on user-specified data and outcome(s) of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human-model interaction enabling formal problem definition and curation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide methods and interfaces that enable subject-matter experts to formally define modeling problems and to curate automatically constructed models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human-model interaction that enables curation of models by subject matter experts. A method and interface will be developed to facilitate human-model interaction that enables formal definition of modeling problems and curation of automatically constructed models by users who are not data scientists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation on progressively harder real-world problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Automated model discovery systems must be tested on real-world problems that increase in difficulty over the course of the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automated model discovery systems developed by the D3M program will be tested on real-world problems that will progressively get harder during the course of the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting unsolved and underspecified problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Toward the end of the program, systems should target problems that are both unsolved and underspecified in terms of available data and instances of outcomes for modeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toward the end of the program, D3M will target problems that are both unsolved and underspecified in terms of data and instances of outcomes available for modeling.
